purpose: Independent source-level clips for future multi-track timeline mixing and user-exported compositions; preserve the established 532 editorial concepts, 35 production sound sources and 45 presets.

distinction.concept: Semantic idea or intent, many source recordings may map to one concept. NOT a physical audio file.
distinction.asset: One identifiable original or authorized derivative with its own unique asset_id, bytes checksum, source evidence, exact usable duration and license.
distinction.sound_page: SEO decision on a concept; not one page per asset.
distinction.composition: Timeline of independently addressable asset instances with gains, start times, loops, fades and automation.
distinction.rendered_export: Explicit user-initiated audio or video render of a rights-cleared composition.

durations_policy.policy: No arbitrary 10-minute ingestion threshold. One-shots may be under one second. Long beds can loop a clean short original with transparent actual independent duration. Technical and editorial QA depend on use-case; 600 seconds is a target duration only for a specifically requested ten-minute master.

licenses.caution: Licenses and user redistributable raw files are different rights. CC BY requires per-file credit. Commercial Freesound API usage requires separate compliance review. YouTube-ready output needs independently verified commercial adaptation/distribution rights for ALL included files.
